name: muayana
description: Muayana — site-audit / snag tracker (NestJS API, Next.js web, shared contract)

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @muayana/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @muayana/api
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @muayana/api
